title: Document stuck in print queue
symptom: A document is stuck in the print queue and nothing else prints
user_description: I sent a document to print an hour ago and it never came out. Now nothing else will print either.

options.text: Send the document again several times
options.why: Adds more jobs behind the stuck one and can cause many duplicate printouts when it clears.
Heavy-handed and disruptive for everyone. It is not a first step for one stuck job.

options.text: Open the print queue, cancel the stuck document, then try printing again
options.why: A single stuck job can block everything behind it. Cancelling it in the print queue clears the block.
Extreme and unnecessary. Never start with the most destructive fix.

hints: Where does Windows hold documents waiting to print?
If the first job in the line is stuck, what happens to the others?
real_world_tip: If the job will not cancel, that is a sign the print spooler needs attention. That is a more advanced fix we cover at a higher level.
